input:
ETR is configured to route trace into a 32MB DRAM region but we observe trace overrun (TMC_STS.Full) within 200ms of enabling. The same workload fits in the 64KB ETF without overflow.

How does AXI bandwidth between the ATB-AXI bridge and DRAM limit sustainable trace bandwidth? What ETR scatter-gather (SG) mode allows non-contiguous DRAM regions, and how does its use of DMA SMMU translation tables interact with normal device DMA traffic? When does Catch-Up mode in TMC_CTL help vs hurt overflow conditions?
